text:
sarah: heads up — noticed quota spikes when route fallback fans out across variants. telemetry shows 1 req -> 3 quota hits :grimacing:
renato: ugh. are these retries or parallel fallbacks?
sarah: parallel fallbacks. routing policy tries primary -> mid -> cheap fallback concurrently for <100ms, picks first, but all three hit quota counters in console.
maria: that's intended for latency SLOs but makes unit cost confusing. console shows 3x burn.
sam: do SDKs propagate any dedupe header today? I think we only send route-id per call.
sarah: currently route-id is in internal header x-rd-route, but it's per-host — when we fanout we set different ids so ledger sees 3 different keys.
renato: could we add an authoritative "x-rd-request-id" generated by the proxy and echoed by SDKs? that way metering can dedupe.
sam: but SDKs don't receive the proxy-generated header on initial client call. they'd need to accept server-side assigned ids.
maria: alternative: SDKs attach a client-generated id and platform uses that for aggregation. TS/Go/Py all already can generate UUIDs.
sarah: true. but we also need to avoid double-charging retries. maybe a canonical header: x-rd-canonical-request: <uuid>
renato: sounds good. small SDK change: ensure client sets that header for all outgoing attempts and doesn't change it across retries. should be backwards compatible if missing.
ci-bot: SDK CI: python client tests failing on header-preservation in async retry path — see logs: ```pytest tests/test_retry.py::test_preserve_canonical_id FAILED``` 
sarah: ok I'll take python. can someone do a quick lint for TS? renato?
renato: will do. TS needs to plumb through fetch/axios wrappers. quick patch:
```js
// in client/request.ts
const canonical = opts.canonicalRequestId || uuidv4();
headers['x-rd-canonical-request'] = canonical;
```
sarah: python patch idea:
```py
# in redwood/client/session.py
canonical = kwargs.pop('canonical_request_id', generate_uuid())
headers['x-rd-canonical-request'] = canonical
# ensure retries reuse the same canonical
session._last_canonical = canonical
```
sam: Go needs attention on http.Client retry wrapper, I'll peek later.
maria: on console side, we'll add an aggregation key 'canonical_request' that dedups quota events within 1s window. But we should expose opt-out toggle to orgs that rely on raw events.
sarah: UX note: add a small tooltip: "dedupe concurrent fanout and retry events when canonical header is present"
renato: rollout plan: feature flag in console + SDK minor release. We'll start with opt-in sampling for a week then flip org-level default.
sam: do we need a migration for older SDKs? If header missing, platform continues current behavior.
sarah: yep. communication: release notes for py/ts/go + console banner.
renato: one more: telemetry — p50/p95 accounting should be based on winner path, not sum of all. implies adjusting latency metrics to attribute to canonical_request's selected backend variant.
maria: agree. that's work on observability pipeline (tagging). i'll open a ticket.
sarah: ok PRs: py (#4321), ts (#4322), go (draft). I'll drop code links once CI green. thanks all :thanks:
sam: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build passed for ts (#4322) on linux
sarah: merging python fix next
